rationale: The Old English lemma 'Geangsumod' in this medical/homiletic context (Homl. Th. ii. 156) most closely aligns with the physiological sense of inflammation — a bodily response characterized by pain, swelling, redness, and heat — rather than the metaphorical or emotional senses. The homiletic attestation suggests a literal, somatic description of bodily affliction consistent with inflammation.n.01.
